title: Whose Language Counts as High Quality? Measuring Language Ideologies in Text Data Selection
reasoning: The paper's central investigation is into 'language ideologies'—the unspoken beliefs and values about language that justify its social use. It evaluates how a technical artifact (a quality filter for an LLM) encodes and perpetuates these ideologies, leading to the preferential selection of language from privileged demographic groups. This constitutes a direct ethical analysis of a data selection process, examining the values and societal biases embedded within it.
